cohort: Employed mothers in Bantul District, Yogyakarta Special Region, Indonesia, whose infants were aged six to 12 months.
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding was associated with a higher prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding among working mothers.
mod_finding: Delivery methods were not significantly related to exclusive breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: When infants were aged six to 12 months
